hard_class_invariants.description: Every validation sweep is ledger-recorded before returning.
Attestation ledger is HMAC-SHA-256 chained; no gaps tolerated.
All internal errors raise; never swallowed silently.
Health score is float in [0.0, 1.0]; out-of-range raises.
Every attestation carries a sealed HMAC digest over all fields.
Certifications are one-way; a certified record cannot be updated.
Score drift >0.20 in one sweep triggers DRIFT_ALERT signal.
Appended records are immutable; mutation raises.
